tables.name: ai_personalizations
tables.description: Stores AI-generated personalized recommendations per user

columns.name: input_data
columns.description: Payload sent to the AI model (preferences, history, etc.)

columns.name: output_data
columns.description: AI response, e.g. list of personalized tips or scores

functions.name: get_user_personalizations
functions.returns: TABLE(id uuid, input_data jsonb, output_data jsonb, model text, created_at timestamptz)
functions.body: RETURN QUERY SELECT id, input_data, output_data, model, created_at FROM ai_personalizations WHERE user_id = user_uuid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT limit;
